blocks.prompt: 8. Which term of the A.P. \(3, 8, 13, \ldots\) is 123? [printed as \(3, 8, 18, \ldots\)]
blocks.explanation:
Humein bataya gaya hai ke 123 is list mein hai; humein us ki position \(n\) dhoondni hai, yani yeh kaunsi term hai.
Plan: \(a_1\), \(d\) aur general term \(a_n\) nikal kar \(a_n = 123\) rakhna, phir \(n\) solve karna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: A.P. \(3, 8, 13, \ldots\)
Humein find karna hai: woh \(n\) jis ke liye \(a_n = 123\).
Tareeqa: \(a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d\) se \(a_n\) ka formula banayenge; phir woh 123 ke barabar rakh kar ek seedhi linear equation solve hogi. Yeh sawal 6 jaisa hi hai, farq yeh ke yahan jawab poora number aayega.

General term nikalein
\[a_1 = 3,\quad d = 8 - 3 = 5\]
\[a_n = 3 + (n - 1)5 = 5n - 2\]
Kyun: Bracket khola: \(3 + 5n - 5 = 5n - 2\). Check: \(n = 2\) par \(10 - 2 = 8\), jo doosri term hai.

\(a_n = 123\) rakhein
\[5n - 2 = 123\]
\[5n = 125\]
\[n = 25\]
Kyun: Dono taraf 2 jama kiya, phir 5 se divide. \(n = 25\) poora natural number hai, is liye 123 waqai list mein hai, aur 25th jagah par.

Tasdeeq
\[a_{25} = 5(25) - 2 = 123 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(n = 25\) wapas formula mein rakha aur 123 hi aaya.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein sequence \(3, 8, 18, \ldots\) chhapi hai, jo A.P. hai hi nahi: \(8 - 3 = 5\) lekin \(18 - 8 = 10\). Teesri term 13 honi chahiye, yani A.P. \(3, 8, 13, \ldots\) jis ka \(d = 5\) hai. Answer key ka jawab 25 bhi isi sequence se milta hai. Sabaq: A.P. ka sawal ho to pehle do farq check kar lijiye.
